title: TikTok Search Scraper + Insights output
description: Scraped TikTok videos with engagement metrics in the dataset, plus an HTML insights report and a JSON summary in the key-value store.

results.title: Videos
results.description: One item per TikTok video: stats, caption, hashtags, creator, video, sound and derived metrics (engagement, share, save and viral ratio, posting hour and weekday, hook).

report.title: Insights report (HTML)
report.description: Best posting hours and weekdays, video length sweet spot, voice-over vs music, hashtag performance, best hooks, small creators that went viral and plain-language takeaways.

summary.title: Insights summary (JSON)
summary.description: The same insights as the HTML report in machine-readable JSON, for dashboards and AI agents.
